description: Asks the human who owns this agent for more budget, and records why. Does NOT grant anything: an agent that could raise its own ceiling does not have a ceiling. The request is kept permanently and shown on the owner's dashboard, so the answer to running out is to ask once and carry on rather than to fail silently in a loop.

amount_usd.description: How much more you are asking for, per day.

deployment.description: The deployment asking. Defaults to you.

reason.description: Why. A human reads this, so say what the extra budget buys them.

name: budget_request_increase
